conflicts.description: European 3RMKE630 edition prints 358 cm3 as the RX stiff-spring standard fork oil; US 31MKE630 edition prints 350 cm3 for both R and RX.
2020 manuals print 0.09/0.19 mm (intake/exhaust); 2022+ manuals and the 2022 Competition Handbook print 0.10/0.20 mm. Different engine generations, not an error.
Competition Handbook 62MKEX00 lists crankshaft replacement at ~30 h (every 12 races R / 8 races RX); the 2021-2025 European owner's manuals omit that line.
Competition Handbook specifies NGK SILMAR10A-9S; 2021-2022 owner's manuals list SILMAR10A-9S standard and SILMAR9A-9S optional; 2023+ owner's manuals list SILMAR9A-9S only.
Spring-install table prints '52 N/mm (319.8 lbf/in)'; 52 N/mm is 296.9 lbf/in elsewhere in Honda documents.
Prints R/RWE wheelbase as 1,483 mm (58.1 in); 1,483 mm is 58.4 in.
